doc: A call that does not finish (an action or guard raises) leaves the machine busy: process() fails with busy until reset(). A process() call from inside an action fails with busy and changes nothing; the outer call goes on.

steps.doc: The exception from xA ends the call, unchanged; eB never runs.
eB sends e1 again: refused with busy; the outer call finishes.
A refused nested call does not latch.
A guard that raises ends the call before anything ran.
An exception during reset() latches too.
